title: Team start + pickup: Cindery Forging Volcano (378172) takes the G4b seat from Seaworthy (e7dd0b) — c1 landed, continuing c2
body:

- Inherited working-tree status (oak-wt-airy-g, feat/g4b-keyword-graph): NON-CLEAN by design — c1 LANDED (73aaedca0, full gates green per Seaworthy's broadcast 8679c43a); c2 keyword view WIP uncommitted: new keyword-projection.ts + keyword-view.ts + keyword-view.integration.test.ts, modified curriculum/index.ts + graph-corpus-emitted.integration.test.ts + graph-corpus-generator.unit.test.ts. - Claim status: opening continuation claim 8ba9e931-3d2a-4e27-897f-357f574ad9ca (continues 15bc9b5d / 718b1d24 lineage). DIRECTOR ASK (no deadline-block): predecessor claims 718b1d24 (Tempestuous, rotated) and 15bc9b5d (Seaworthy, rotated) need closure disposition at your hand; also please add my identity row to the eef thread record (your .agent/memory boundary).
- Constraint or risk: Seaworthy dispatched code-expert + test-expert on the c1 diff (their broadcast 8679c43a); those verdicts died with their session — I will re-dispatch on the c1 diff alongside my c2 review unless the Director says they already absorbed them.
- Gate-verification offer: running my own seat worktree's gates now (seat-scoped; no shared-tree contention).
Plan: verify c2 WIP against the c2 spec (anchored bounded frequency-ranked + edge decoration + well-formed empty), complete c2, then c3, ONE PR per claim intent, Director-serialised merge.
